title: Acme launch film
summary: What is new in this version, in one or two sentences.

scenes.name: Cold open
lines: And never enough hours in the day
scenes.change: Chips pile up around the hero at different depths.

motion.carries: the hero photo stays still with a 4% push-in

scenes.sound: Music builds as the pile grows; no arrival effects.

to_next.carries: the hero's chip shrinks into the first mosaic tile
to_next.easing: power3.inOut; color hard-cuts on the first word
to_next.camera: locked frame; hard color cut on motion

scenes.name: Platform
scenes.change: Tiles fill the brand shape one group at a time.

motion.move: Tiles fly in on curved paths

scenes.sound: Music's first full beat lands with the last tile.

to_next.carries: the hero's tile opens into the product surface

scenes.name: Home
scenes.change: The draft lifts toward the camera; the cursor clicks it.
scenes.motion: Single frame: the call row lifts 120px toward the camera over 0.45s (power3.out) and unfolds into the draft; cursor travels 0.75s (power3.out), settles 0.15s, presses 0.08s; the draft writes in line by line; the result holds still 1.2s.

rules: Top-center about 9% down; center only when nothing else is on screen.
